Airplane-engine maintenance is now a money spinner
Manufacturers are earning big bucks as a result

Among the eye-catching announcements at this week’s Farnborough International Airshow, a biennial aerospace get-together, was a deal signed by IndiGo, a fast-growing Indian carrier. It will procure over 1,000 Leap jet engines from CFM, a joint venture between America’s GE Aerospace and Safran of France.
